insight.headline: New fields for cash management
insight.what_changed: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and cashCountActivities connection are now available. This change allows for more accurate tracking of cash management activities.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the GraphQL Admin API should update their queries to include the new fields for cash management activities and drawers. This will provide more detailed information about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The new fields can be accessed through the cashManagement resource. No migration is required, but developers should test their queries to ensure they are working as expected. The GraphQL Admin API version 2026-10 includes these changes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed information about their cash management activities, allowing them to better track and manage their cash flow.
insight.why_it_matters: This change provides more detailed information about cash management activities, allowing developers to build more accurate and informative analytics and reporting tools for merchants.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality, developer tools, and fulfillment services

themes.title: Storefront and Cart Updates
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and the updateCart standard action updates cart attributes. Additionally, WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with the storefront.

themes.title: Developer Tools and Hydrogen
themes.detail: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. The CLI has also been updated to serve UI extension source maps during app development.

themes.title: Fulfillment Services and Order Management
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated to better reflect real-world fulfillment operations.
